mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: poster reports King main thrust bearings from 2024-on production measuring out of spec and slipping into the cap/block groove without an interference fit, raising a spun-thrust risk. Thread still open, no King reply; latest post 3 Jun 2026 where the OP reports switching to NOS Clevite thrust bearings that measured in spec.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: still no King or official brand reply, thread open and not locked, and the newest post is unchanged at 3 June 2026 where the OP reports his replacement NOS Clevite thrust bearings measured in spec.
